title: Package Export Map Migration Plan
gradingCriteria: Recognizes that adding a restrictive `exports` map is a public boundary change because it can break deep import consumers even if those imports were undocumented.
Separates internal workspace cleanup from external compatibility: block or migrate new internal deep imports now while giving known external customers a deprecation path.
Proposes a staged export map that keeps the root entrypoint and either temporarily exposes documented compatibility subpaths or ships a major-version breaking change with clear migration notes.
Updates package README as the owner of public API and import-path documentation before or with the package metadata change.
Removes `src` from published files only when generated `dist` artifacts and declarations cover the supported public subpaths.
Verification includes pack inspection, type checking downstream consumers, import smoke tests for supported paths, and a search or lint guard for forbidden internal deep imports.
